reviews.title: Mandatory Apple Music subscription required
reviews.text: I tried the app and quite liked it. Then unsubscribed and tried a daily lesson. The last stage is to ‘Sing Your Favourite Song’, except it has to be from Apple Music and you have to have a subscription to Apple Music to load the songs. Is this app sponsored by Apple??

reviews.title: Using Apple Music
reviews.text: I am literally stuck on an exercise just because I am under pressure to use Apple Music. This is not fair. I’m very disappointed.

reviews.title: Worthless
reviews.text: Make sure you are not charged the full (annual) fee! If that is not what you want! I knew right away it was not for me, yet they sneakily took the full price anyway! I am really upset about this! The whole process is unhelpful! Do not purchase this, you will learn nothing!

reviews.title: Apple Music Subscription Required
reviews.text: You can’t use this app without also paying for Apple Music. You literally cannot play any song. They give you no other options even though they make it seem like you could have an option as there is a “setting” to turn off Apple subscription, but it doesn’t actually work, it just blocks you into not being able to do step 7 in any daily warm up. I am not a fan of Apple Music so this won’t work out for me. The warm ups are okay. The app can be glitchy at times, especially the AI thing.

reviews.title: Please make this work with Spotify
reviews.text: I feel like I’m missing out on a big part of this app because I don’t have Apple Music. Please make this compatible with Spotify 🥹 also the tuner is bad and caps out at F#6 even though I can hit an F7. Using a frequency analyzer is a lot more accurate
